Methods We conducted a phase 1 trial involving adults with relapsed B‐cell ALL who received an infusion of autologous T cells expressing the 19‐28z CAR at the Memorial Sloan Kettering Cancer Center (MSKCC). Safety and long‐term outcomes were assessed, as were their associations with demographic, clinical, and disease characteristics.
